summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony: analyze the confidential supplier/ERP data, find launch-critical contradictions, and build a generic agent product that rechecks on every portal drop and acts (emails suppliers, asks for approval) with a calm phone-first UI.
summary.outcome: Found that the Collector's Edition (and later game cards for Standard) miss the Sunday launch despite a plan saying 'ok'. Built a polling/versioned pipeline, verifier fix (game cards 34,800 -> 6,800 short), calm Today flow with email review, routines with a When/Then/Always diagram, and a two-step voice decision. Pushed everything to `jonas/today-flow`, with the latest restyle and suggestions endpoint committed locally.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) and no webhooks. Change detection must poll and compare SHA-256, because files are replaced under the same name and formats may change.
Confidential portal data lives in the gitignored `data/` folder; `.env` is ignored and `.env.example` is committed. Nothing from the data should be hardcoded or committed.
Team workflow requires CLAUDE.md/PROGRESS.md claims, Entire enabled, and Brain connected before pushing. Entire only writes checkpoints when repo files change.
The image recognizer put the part number in the `item` field with an empty `material_id`, so the shortfall linker needed a part-number fallback when mapping doc lines.
Legacy routines written as code have no recipe, so they cannot render a diagram. New routines are recipes and default to 'ask' mode.
Email sends cannot be undone. The UI now shows an email review dialog first, and Undo is kept only for internal steps.

code.finding: Each part carries `arriving` and `not_counted` lists. gap = needed - usable - arriving. Inbound counts only if ETA is on or before launch, it is not cancelled or arrived, it has no receipt in the ETD to stock-date window, and the supplier document doesn't say less. Unread shipping docs are not counted (conservative).
The wide view was rewritten into When/Then/Always lanes that wrap. The narrow vertical view stays for the panel and phone.
Holds the Focus decision view with email review before send, source sheet, voice prepare/decide guard, and inline automation proposals.

workflow: Run one-off analysis in the main session and use subagents for bulk cross-checks (200 order confirmations, 59 scans). Give a single builder the whole front end to avoid edit conflicts.
Verify UI changes on real data by viewing only, and use Playwright with mocked POSTs so no real supplier email goes out.
Ask before any paid API call (the one OpenAI reading, a fraction of a cent) and before pushing branches.
Portal data is unannounced and changes: five new files arrived within 37 minutes, so recheck regularly.

friction: Portal token was empty at first, which blocked data access (401) until the user supplied it.
Voice agent said it would outline the decision but then just said 'done', which led to the two-step prepare/decide token flow.
The dashboard kept showing 34,800 game cards short locally until a shipping-advice reading existed; the first fix wasn't enough without the linker fallback.
The Today screen briefly attributed the Standard stop to the wrong card (Sat 22:00), requiring an attribution fix.
Undo was shown for sent emails, and routine views (Flow/Steps/Expand) were redundant.
Legacy code-only routines failed and showed no diagram, so they were backed up and removed.
A mid-session rebuild was blocked until another builder's files compiled again.
`.vite/` cache folder appeared in the repo root and was left out of the commit.
open_items: Push the latest commits (restyle, suggestions endpoint, silent-shipment ring pulse) to `jonas/today-flow`; PR #5 still holds the older state and a merge into `main` is undecided.

Voice flow is untested end to end (no mic), and an email edited on screen then confirmed by voice sends the original draft.
